_comment: Codeline-specific gotchas, injected verbatim into agent prompts as authoritative. Every fact carries a `source`: where in that codeline the claim is OBSERVABLE, so it can be re-checked and expired. A fact whose source cannot be named does not belong here. On 2026-08-03 an unverified third-party API claim was written into this file by an assistant session; it reached three writers and the reviewer as fact and caused correct work to be rejected across all three codelines. Fact text is unchanged from the entries that survived that audit.

facts.text: Local dev/pre-commit hooks require real Contentstack env vars (CONTENTSTACK_API_KEY, CONTENTSTACK_DELIVERY_TOKEN, CONTENTSTACK_ENVIRONMENT, CONTENTSTACK_BRANCH) to be set — next.config.js throws 'Missing required environment variables' at import time if they're absent, which breaks tsc/next-lint inside the husky pre-commit hook even when the source change itself is correct.
facts.source: next.gotransit.com/next.config.js — the import-time env assertion; observed breaking the husky pre-commit hook during a run

facts.text: Date/locale tests assert UTC-rendered dates (this project's CI runs in UTC) — running with a non-UTC TZ produces off-by-one-day test failures unrelated to any real code change.
facts.source: next.gotransit.com — the codeline's own date assertions plus its CI TZ setting

facts.text: @metrolinx/cx-shared is resolved from a local override (npm pack + file: install) when the GitHub Packages registry is unreachable — a direct directory reference instead of a packed tarball pulls in cx-shared's own node_modules and causes a dual-React 'Invalid hook call' failure.
facts.source: next.upexpress.com/package.json — the file: dependency reference for @metrolinx/cx-shared; the dual-React failure was observed directly
